steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator before servicing. Wait 3 minutes after unplugging before measuring SMPS terminals (160 Vdc may remain). R-134a sealed-system precautions apply.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing electrical parts.

steps.title: Test Mode 1 — damper open
steps.body: Press main PCB test button once — main stepping damper fully OPEN (baffle open); OptiChill damper CLOSED.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press main PCB test button once — main stepping damper fully OPEN (baffle open); OptiChill damper CLOSED.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: PCB test mode entered. Continue with component-specific checks below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After §2-17 test mode entry, proceed with OEM component tests.

steps.title: Main damper open?
steps.body: Verify fresh-food airflow increases when main damper opens in Test Mode 1.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify fresh-food airflow increases when main damper opens in Test Mode 1.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace stepping damper motor or main PCB driver.

steps.title: Test Mode 2 — damper closed
steps.body: From Test 1, press test button once — compressor and fans OFF, defrost heater ON, main damper CLOSED.
steps.sourceExcerpt: From Test 1, press test button once — compressor and fans OFF, defrost heater ON, main damper CLOSED.

steps.title: Main damper closed?
steps.body: Verify damper closes in Test Mode 2 (forced defrost).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify damper closes in Test Mode 2 (forced defrost).

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace stepping damper motor when stuck open/closed.

steps.title: Replace damper
steps.oemOutcome: Replace stepping damper motor or main PCB driver output.

steps.title: Damper verified
steps.oemOutcome: Main and OptiChill damper motion verified via Test 1/2.
